The curve g has the same shape (same vertical asymptote at x = 0, same rate of growth), but every point is raised by 4 units:
- At x = 1: g ≈ 4 (while f = 0)
- At x = 8: g ≈ 6.1 (while f ≈ 2.1)
- The marked point on f near (0, −4) corresponds to the marked point on g near (0, 1)... checking vertical distances at several x-values consistently gives a difference of 4.

So g is f shifted up 4 units: g(x) = ln(x) + 4.
